A train control system that served as brain and nerves of the urban rail transit system decided whether the train is able to run safely and constantly on schedule with a high density, which was a key influencing factor for the urban rail transit service quality. The service quality that can be perceived by passengers was visible to them, however, the train control system is invisible to passengers. It is of great significance for urban rail transit service quality to establish the correlations between the invisible train control system and visible service quality. This work theoretically illustrated the correlations in an intuitive manner by innovatively introducing rail transit traffic flow as an intermediary for impacts of the train control system on rail transit service quality. The correlations between characteristic parameters of rail transit traffic flow and evaluation indexes of service quality was set up, and thus further the model to describe the correlations was developed by regarding rail transit traffic flow characteristic parameters as the bridge. The train control system could be optimized according to the passengers' feedback to transit service quality based on the established model.

articleTitle: A study on lenders' perceived uncertainty and willingness to bid in Online P2P lending
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: P2P lending is a new phenomenon and characterized by strongly asymmetric information which is known to lead to adverse selection and moral hazard. It is difficult for lenders to make bid decisions when they encounter tremendous request listings because they perceive high level of uncertainty and complexity. The purpose of current study is to find and identify the antecedents of perceived uncertainty, and elaborate the impact of perceived uncertainty on willingness to bid in the context of P2P lending.

articleTitle: Supply chain analysis with considerations of free emission permit allocation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: With more attention to environmental issues, tradeable carbon emission permits become a new type of firm's business resource. Many firms take emission permits into consideration in the original raw materials-products (services) production process when making operational decisions. Therefore, based on carbon emission permits trading, this paper studies the emission reduction decision for firms along the supply chain and the decision of how to allocate the emission permits among firms from the government's perspective. Game theory is applied to analyze the upstream and downstream firms' emission reduction effects and profits under three different forms of cooperation. The interaction in the supply chain and the total profit of the supply chain are also analyzed. The results show that under three different forms of cooperation, cooperation in both emission reduction and pricing can achieve high efficiency of reduction and high profits. For the government, allocating emission permits by production quantity rather than curbing the total emissions can achieve more obvious emission reduction effect, and the effect is more obvious if the level of cooperation between firms is higher.

articleTitle: Optimizing the inventory allocation problem between automobile manufacturer and 4S stores
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Most domestic automobile manufacturers always keep a great amount of inventories generally because of the expansion of production capacity. In order to cope with the problem, the automobile manufacturers attempt to transfer the inventory risk to 4S stores by the means of distributing the sales target to the 4S stores. This leads to a sharp increase in its 4S stores' inventories, and the game between the two sides on the inventory coefficient is getting more and more intense. Based on the obtained data through investigating self-owned brand automobile stores' inventory, this paper puts forward a feasible database-based optimization scheme first and then establishes a model respectively, to optimize the automobile manufacturers' decision for improving the inventory status of 4S stores and mitigating the channel conflict between the two sides.

articleTitle: Neurological impact of the conflict between brand and product performance on consumer decision process
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This research aims to study the neural influence of conflict between brand and product performance on consumer decision. In the experiment, stimuli of products with brand and performance information were displayed randomly. 22 subjects need to decide whether to buy, while the event-related potentials (ERPs) were recorded. The stimuli were divided into four conditions based on the consistency of brand and performance (condition 1: well-known brand and superior performance; condition 2: well-known brand and inferior performance; condition 3: unknown brand and superior performance; condition 4: unknown brand and inferior performance). Thus, this paper focuses on two conflicting stimuli - conditions (2) and (3). Results showed that conditions (2) had higher purchase rate than condition (3). Although both conditions (2) and (3) have conflicting information, condition (2) evoked the higher amplitude of conflict-related N270 than condition (3) in the prefrontal regions, which meant the actual performance is different from the expectation established by the brand and evoke the conflict between the stimulus and the endogenous information. An essential component of ERPs, P300, was elicited in among all parietal and occipital regions in all conditions, but the P300 amplitude triggered by condition (3) was significantly larger than condition (2). The findings consisted with the results of N270. The findings explain the neurological and psychological activities when consumers are browsing products. Hence, N270 and P300 may be useful neural endogenous indicators to reflect the process of handling conflicts and evaluation of products in consumer decision.

articleTitle: An empirical study on online takeaway platform continuance intention based on expectation confirmation model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: With the development of online takeaway platform (OTP), research on OTP continuance has emerged as a new frontier among information system and marketing field. This study develops an integrated model to research OTP continuance intention based on expectation confirmation model. The proposed model is empirically evaluated using an online survey of 269 effective respondents. The results show that confirmation is positively related to perceived factors and satisfaction. Information quality is found to have a direct impact on continuance intention while service quality has an important influence on satisfaction. At last, this paper proposes several strategic suggestions for OTP managers to improve continuance intention effectively.

articleTitle: Under production capacity constraints analysis of and quality differentiated motivation of service enterprise
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Based on the choice of quality differentiated level of service enterprises. under production capacity constraints, this paper analyzes the effect of production capacity constraints on quality differentiated motivation of service enterprises. The research result shows that under Bertrand competition and quality differentiation, when existing the production capacity restriction, production may supplant quality differentiation, the production capacity constraints weakened the quality differentiated motivation of service enterprises, and there is less difference between service enterprises 'products quality. The conclusion explain the reason of service enterprises providing homogeneity products in China, and the paper analyzes the feature of service enterprises existing capacity constraints easily suggests solutions to the problem of homogeneity products.

articleTitle: An application of Kano model to identify quality attributes of smart tourism
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Tourism firms are realizing the significance of customer-centered philosophies and are turning to quality management approaches to help managing their businesses in the context of smart tourism. This paper started with the concept of smart tourism and applied Kano model to identify basic quality elements concerned by tourists in the context of smart tourism, which may help firms to understand better how to improve the service quality.

articleTitle: A service value co-creation process model for energy saving service business using inverters or transformers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This research proposes a new methodology of maximizing the co-created service value based on the service attribute vectors, which provides the process to evaluate and maximize the service value mathematically. The service value is evaluated by an inner product of service attribute vectors. It is applied to the service value co-creation process - KIKI model. In order to show the effectiveness of the proposed methodology, a case of energy saving service business using inverters as a product service system is investigated.

articleTitle: Multi-response optimization considering quality loss and rejection cost
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: In this paper, a new multi-response optimization (MRO) approach is proposed to find the optimal parameter setting of the controllable factors from an economic point of view. In some cases, rejection costs, like the rework cost and scrap cost, are incurred when outgoing products fall above the upper specification limit or below the lower specification limit. A rejection cost function is established when the output responses fail to meet their specification limits from the viewpoint of customers. In addition, there still exists different quality level when two different responses fall within their corresponding specification limits. A multivariable quality loss function is used to calculate the expected quality loss (i.e., bias, quality of prediction and robustness) when output responses fall within their corresponding specification limits. Finally, an integrated cost function including rejection cost and quality loss is minimized by using a hybrid genetic algorithm with pattern search. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through an example from the literature.

articleTitle: Inefficiency of marginal-cost tolls in transportation networks with stochastic demands
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This Congestion tolls provide an efficient way to mitigate traffic congestion. In deterministic networks, an optimal routing of traffic can arise as a user equilibrium by levying marginal-cost toll. In reality, traffic demands vary day in day out. The uncertainty of demand brings difficulties to design transport policies in theory and to implement the traffic coordination in practice. The expected travel budget is defined by involving the mean marginal-cost toll into the expected travel time, and a equilibrium model is established. We compare the expected social cost of the equilibrium and the system optimum to find the efficiency loss of the marginal-cost toll. It is found that the network performance degrades as demand variation goes up. Thus the control of demand variation could be an effective assistant tool to improve the efficiency of congestion pricing policies.

articleTitle: Research on storing and retrieving problem in a ship block stockyard
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Storing and retrieving problem for assembly blocks in a ship block stockyard is an important operational problem in shipyards. It affects not only the operation efficiency of stockyard but also the productivity and coordination of workshops. This paper formulates a mathematical model with the purpose of reducing unproductive moves in a stockyard. A heuristic approach is proposed combining a relocating strategy based on Tabu search structure.

articleTitle: Empirical study on effect of IPO secondary offerings on IPO underpricing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: IPO secondary offerings have been widely concerned by people. The purpose of this paper is to study the effect of IPO secondary offerings on IPO underpricing in China's capital market. The data about IPO secondary offerings and IPO underpricing in the Shanghai and Shenzhen A stock market listed companies from December 2013 to April 2016 are used for empirical analysis. The study finds that the IPO secondary offerings has a significant effect on the IPO underpricing, and with the increase in the proportion of IPO secondary offerings, IPO underpricing tends to decline. Further analysis and tests show that in the good market, the inhibitory effect of IPO secondary offerings on IPO underpricing will be weakened, but it makes no difference in the SME board. On the main board market IPO secondary offerings has no significant influence on IPO underpricing. On the GEM and SME board market IPO secondary offerings has significant influence on IPO underpricing and the two are negatively correlated. The results further verify the role of IPO secondary offerings on IPO underpricing, and provide some inspirations for the improvement of China's capital market.

articleTitle: What is the influence of Internet on the development of e-commerce in China?
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: China's Internet has been over 30 years of development, but there are still many problems. According to China's 2011-2015 correlation data, the evaluation index system of internet gaps established. A clustering is on the current situation of the development of Internet of China's 31 provinces and regions. The digital divide phenomenon focus on Internet development indicators measuring is obvious in our country, and further analysis of the various regions of e-commerce transactions, Internet-based resources and the popularity of the Internet in the relationship between the degree of Internet development indexes, the study found China's e-commerce transactions on the Internet resources and the popularity of the Internet there is a certain degree of dependence.

articleTitle: Text data analysis of customer voice about omotenashi of the Onsen Ryokan
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Omotenashi is attracted as Japan original high-service to the tourism industry particularly. Omotenashi in Japan is underlying traditional culture to the equal relationship base between hosts and guests, unlike hospitality in Europe and America in the provision of services based on a master-servant relationship. One of the characteristics of omotenashi in the Japan traditional inns, so called “Ryokan” in Japanese, is unique. Many ryokans are managed by a small family operation, have different ideas and the type of its omotenashi, unlike the hotel operation with a large group enterprise is unified in the world wide. Therefore, it is important for ryokans to deliver better omotenashi that the customers are satisfied, as ryokans provide different omotenashi with the manager's mindset. It is ambiguous and weird which omotenashi have customers satisfied with various and different omotenashi. Thus, this research identifies the character and factors of omotenashi by extracting customer voice or voice-of-mouth on the Internet travel agency and analyzing the relation of customer satisfaction. As a result, the factors of omotenashi are 1. Mael, 2. Facility & environment, 3. Staff members, 4. Hospitality mind and 5. Access by car. Then, the field research was undertaken to investigate the reason and background of the result with the statistical data analysis. This study caused the unique significance of the supplemental field research, though most previous research has not accomplished with a comprehensive questionnaire survey.

articleTitle: Model for the multiple depots heterogeneous dial-aride problem with flexible depots
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper studies a new dial-a-ride problem (DARP) called multiple depots heterogeneous dial-a-ride problem with flexible depots (MHDARP-FD), which considered multiple depots, heterogeneous vehicles and users, and flexible depots. The assumption of flexible depots allows the vehicle to end its route at any depot. As a result, the total travel cost may be reduced. A mixed integer nonlinear programming model was firstly formulated for the considered problem. To make the MHDARP-FD tractable, the original model was reformulated by linearizing constraints, aggregating variables, and strengthening model. The new model is solved by the state-of-the-art IP solver CPLEX. Computational results of numerical experiments show the validity of the proposed model and its effectiveness for addressing realistic problem.

articleTitle: The impact of information factors on online recommendation adoption
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: With the advent of large data age, the recommendation system began to enter people's lives, according to the user's habits, how to recommend will become the future business development trend. In this paper, we used Elaboration Likelihood Model (ELM) to demonstrate the important adoption factors on the recommendation system such as the recommendation persuasiveness, recommendation source credibility, recommendation completeness and recommendation credibility. Finally, we show that only recommendation information completeness is not significant on readers' perception of recommendation credibility, others are best for it. And recommendation source credibility and recommendation credibility are both effective effect on recommendation adoption.

articleTitle: A link-based day-to-day traffic evolution model with limited path set
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper proposes a link-based day-to-day discrete dynamic model with limited path set, which considers road users' heterogeneity that allows the numbers of the limited path sets for each user to be different. The new day-to-day dynamic is constructed based on one new constraint set. Then discrete-time version is tested on a road network under different conditions and numerical results indicate that the fixed point of our dynamic is the N-path user equilibrium. Finally, sensitivity analysis about two parameters is discussed.

articleTitle: Empirical research on incentive factors for engineering construction and management talents in new era: A case study of organization H
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Using the case of organization H, this paper studies the current development of scientific and technological talents. Based on recent research in this filed, we develop an index system of incentive factors, including material incentive, implicit incentive, support incentive and growth incentive. Then we survey 244 scientific and technological talents and use factor analysis method to study the valid data. Our results reveal the real needs of technology professionals in organization H. The results also show that the primary incentive factors include external and internal driving forces. External driving force includes the remuneration, welfare policy, work content, working conditions, platform, accessing to information and participation in decision-making, while internal driving force factor includes the value of research results value, unknown areas attractiveness, the allocation of resources, personal development and playing specialty.

articleTitle: Sustainability awards and the market value of the firm: An empirical investigation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper empirically estimates the impact of sustainability development on the market value of the firm. We use a firm's receipt of a sustainability award as a proxy for its sustainability development effectiveness. Based on data from 398 announcements of sustainability awards given to the firms during the period 2010–2015, the evidence suggests that, on average, the stock market reaction to sustainability award winning announcement is value neutral, the stock market reacts more positively under certain award giver category. We conclude that companies should analyze and choose better sustainable action to enhance companies' competitiveness.

articleTitle: Appointment of container drayage services: A primary literature review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Truck arrival appointment for the purpose of traffic congestion relief has attracted much academic attentions. Therefore, this paper presents a primary literature review on the research addressing appointments of container drayage services. The review is organized from four aspects as follows: the basic appointment problem at gates with or without considering yards, the problem considering trucking companies, the problem considering timetables of vessels, and the performance analyses of appointments in applications including the reasons why existing appointment methods cannot be applied widely. Finally, several potential research directions are provided.

articleTitle: Analysis on safety risk and structure relations of special equipment based on the perspective of supervision
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Special equipment safety is an important component of national public security. Government, as the main body for serving and managing the whole society, implementing safety regulatory responsibilities is one of the important means to ensure special equipment safety. Based on the perspective of supervision, the safety risk factors of special equipment are analyzed, interpretive structural modeling(ISM) is applied to analyze the safety risk structure of special equipment, and the multilevel hierarchy figure is built, which provide basis for the government in better understanding and controlling of the special equipment safety risk and implementing regulation measures.

articleTitle: Inventory models for perishable product with two-period shelf life
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper studies inventory models for a perishable product with lost sales under the first-in-first-out inventory issuing rule. The lifetime of perishable product is equal to two selling periods. At the beginning of the first period, the manager decides an order quantity, and at the end of the period he has a chance to reorder or return some items. Therefore, we develop two kinds of inventory models, i.e., one is the inventory model with reorder policy and the other is the inventory model with return policy. We find that each inventory model is determined by an inventory threshold. A high inventory threshold is for the return policy, and a low inventory threshold is for the reorder policy. The reorder policy will be used only when the surplus inventory at the end of the first period is less than the low threshold, while the reorder policy will be used only when the surplus inventory at the end of the first period is higher than the high threshold. We also show that each inventory policy has its merit and demerit.

articleTitle: The impact of venture capital on corporate performance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Using the data of firms listed on the Growth Enterprises Market Board (GEM) in China from 2009 to 2014, this paper investigates the influence of venture capital (VC) on corporate performance from three time dimensions—pre-IPO, post-IPO, and from pre-IPO to post-IPO. First, our findings indicate that China's GEM market also has “IPO Effect”, which is consistent with foreign capital markets that there is a general decline trend of corporate performance after IPO. Furthermore, before IPO, VC-backed enterprises have better corporate performance than those Non-VC-backed enterprises, but this is mainly due to the high earnings management level manipulated by VC. Finally, after IPO, corporate performance of VC backed enterprises is lower than that of Non-VC-backed enterprises. The results show that VC's participation will increase the decline level of performance from pre-IPO to post-IPO. These research results are of great importance to the guidance of Chinese venture capital towards a healthy direction.

articleTitle: The selection of logistics service provider based on rough set and unascertained measure model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: As market competition intensifies, the logistics part is being a new profit growth point, and it is critical for businesses to select the appropriate logistics service providers. Existing logistics service provider selection method is too subjective and evaluation index is not comprehensive. On the basis of considering the impact factors to logistics service providers selected evaluation, this paper established a logistics service provider selection evaluation system, then it applied rough set theory to reduce attribute and extract the core factors. It used information entropy to determine index objectivity weight and establishing to evaluate logistics service providers. The evaluation results improved the objectivity and accuracy.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: Theory and Principle of Service Sciences; Service System Design, Operations, and Management; Supply Chain Management for Service; Service Marketing and Financial Management; Specific Industrial Service Management; Service Information Technology and Decision Making; Service Empirical Studies and Case Studies; Management of healthcare services; Electronic business new models and strategies; and Data analytics and service management.

articleTitle: The effect of corporate social responsibility on hotel employees' work outcomes: The mediating role of organizational identification
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Corporate social responsibility (CSR) has received growing attention in the past decade by both researchers and practitioners. However, prior hospitality research has mainly studied CSR from the firm's and customer's perspectives, our current understanding of CSR from employees' perspective is limited. In this study, we collected data from 260 employees of four hotels in China to test the effect of CSR practices towards employees on employees work outcomes. The results showed that hotels' CSR practices towards employees not only directly influenced employees' work engagement and organizational citizenship behavior, but also indirectly influenced them through employees' organizational identification. Based on the research findings, suggestions were given to hospitality practitioners to make more efforts to undertake the social responsibility for employees to raise the level of employee organizational identification and work engagement, so as to improve the hotel performance and profitability.

articleTitle: Optimal dynamic pricing for fresh products under the cap-and-trade scheme
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper focuses on an emission dependent supply chain consisting of one emission-dependent manufacturer and one emission-permit supplier under the carbon-and-trade scheme, where emission permission becomes requisite for production. We consider the emission cap of fresh products manufacturer allocated by the government and investigate its influence on decision-makings. An optimal control model is also established to maximize the total profit for manufacturer and supplier, where the demand not only depends on the current price, but also is sensitive to the historical price. The dynamic optimal pricing strategy is obtained through solving the optimal control model. In addition, numerical simulations and sensitivity analysis are carried out and some suggestions are proposed to formulate their pricing policies.

articleTitle: Research on the effect of customer relationships, service failure on customer behavior
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Service characteristic of invisibility, heterogeneity, concurrency, which increases the chance of failures, existing research thinks that good customer relationship can influence customer behavior after the service failure, ease service failure loss, but there are also study points out the customer relationship will strengthen negative reaction of service failure. Based on two-dimensional construct idea about customer's Personality-relatedness and Reciprocity features (Kaltcheva 2012), the article introduced service recovery variables, and studied customer relationships, service failure effect on the customer behavior. The study found that customer relationship has certain influence on the probability of silent exit, destructive voice of customer after service mistakes appear. The research extended the customer relationship and customer service mistakes reaction model, the results has important practical guiding significance to save service failure losses of the service industry, ensure satisfaction and loyalty of customer, and maintain enterprise brand.

articleTitle: Contract type of complementary product and service with quantity decisions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: As the popularity of service-dominant logic, it is agreeable that service becomes new engine of business. Since many firms position their focuses on service, the traditional contracts are no longer suitable and many conflicts emerge between supply chain members. Indeed, the firm who provides service is willing to capture all the profit from service, while its partner who supplies product has incentive to share. In practice, firms have tried different contracts to coordinate their preferences, but sometimes result in problems. Motivated by the practice in the wireless industry, we consider a supply chain consisting of a handset vendor and a service provider and facing heterogeneous consumers. We develop a game theoretical model, characterize the two widely used contracts to deliver complementary product and service, compare the performances, and derive firms' preferences over these contracts. We find that revenue sharing contracts lead to larger market coverage than wholesale price contracts in general. However, the revenue sharing contract could be agreeable by both firms if and only if consumers are not too homogeneous; otherwise, the service provider has incentive to switch to the wholesale price contract. Moreover, no matter which contract is adopted, firms serve the whole market if and only if consumers are not too heterogeneous; otherwise, low-valuation consumers will be given up.

articleTitle: Optimal pricing decisions for closed-loop supply chain with different disposal responsibilities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper studies the optimal pricing decisions with three players e.g. the OEM, government, and the customers, when considering different disposal responsibilities in a closed-loop supply chain. For OEM, we propose the equilibrium price of new products when OEM faces different regulations of trade-in subsidy from the government respectively. Some factors such as discount of customer residual valuation for used products and proportion of the trade-in subsidy undertaken by the firm which influence the equilibrium price are also discussed in this paper. Finally, based on the equilibrium price of new products in different circumstances, we also make a further discussion to get more meaningful managerial insights.

articleTitle: Are big data talents different from business intelligence expertise?: Evidence from text mining using job recruitment advertisements
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: As more and more companies become aware of the benefits of collecting and analyzing data, hiring employee with data analytics expertise is a key issue faced by HR practitioners. Although previous research empirically highlighted the differences of knowledge and skill requirements between big data (BD) and business intelligence (BI) in English-speaking countries, limited similar study is conducted in China. By analyzing and interpreting the topic modeling results with dataset extracted from online job recruitment website Zhaopin.com, this exploratory study reveals that (1) the demand for BD competencies is far bigger (nearly six times) than the demand for BI competencies in China job market; (2) for Chinese employer, hard skills, especially those advanced analytic and programming skills, are much emphasized when HR searching for qualified BD applicants; (3) given the large volume and unstructured nature of big data, BD investments are currently much more human-capital-intensive than BI projects are. Our findings not only enhance the understanding of similarities and differences in BI and BD areas of competency but also provide guidance for organizations to choose suitable HR decisions.

articleTitle: Research on linked organization and visualization aggregation of shipping digital resource: An open data perspective
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: At present, more and more government departments and organizations choose to open their own data to the outside world. Open data can expand the scope of data sharing and improve the use efficiency of digital resources. However, most of the open data presents massive, decentralized and heterogeneous characteristics that greatly limit the use of open data. Also, semantic interoperability between data from different sources cannot be achieved. In addition, the user's application of open data mainly focuses on the lower level such as “data download” and “data retrieval”. The analysis of the patterns hidden behind open data is not sufficient. Therefore, from the perspective of open data, taking shipping digital resources as an example, this paper uses the linked data technology to realize the linked organization of data resources. On this basis, the visualization scheme of shipping digital resources is designed and implemented, so as to maximize the value of open digital resource. Our work in this paper provides a reference suggestion for effective use of open digital resources in other domain.

articleTitle: Research on the key factors and strategies of bottleneck causes of technological innovation in automobile industry based on ANP method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: The automobile industry in China has gradually entered the bottleneck stage of technological innovation recently. There are many problems such as deficiency in independent brands, lack of technological innovation capacity and so on, which seriously restricts the long-term and healthy development of Chinese automobile industry. Based on the analysis of the causes of the bottleneck of automobile enterprises' technological innovation, this paper established the identified structure model. And then, using the ANP analysis method, this paper found that the deficiency in technological innovation personnel, the insufficiency in R&D investment and the lack of technological innovation ability are three key factors that cause China's bottleneck of technological innovation in automobile industry. Finally, this paper put forward the corresponding measures to improve the technological innovation ability of automobile industry.

articleTitle: Multimodal transportation network optimization with environmental and economic performance considered: An ongoing research
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: An optimization model is proposed in this paper to solve the transportation mode selection and the demand allocation problem with environmental and economic performance considered. The case study based on the regional logistics of Pearl River Delta (PRD) in Guangdong province of China illustrates that the optimal solution changes significantly when carbon emission is introduced into the optimization objective. More ocean and less ordinary road transportation will be adopted when environmental performance matters, and it is possible to greatly reduce the carbon emission while keeping the transportation cost not increase dramatically. However, there exist a tradeoff between emission reduction and the transportation cost. The proposed model can also be extended to take the transportation time and due dates of demands into consideration in the process of multimodal transportation network optimization.

articleTitle: A scenario-based robust optimization approach for surgeries scheduling with a single specialised human resource server
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper addresses a surgeries scheduling problem with a single server in charge of key medical facility. A surgery can be processed with a precedent setup by the server on one of available operating rooms. The setup can be processed at only one surgery at any time. Thus, it is critically important to simultaneously consider the setup precedence and operating room scheduling decisions. A robust model is presented for the problem to minimize the makespan associated with an uncertainty set for surgery durations. In order to verify the developed model and evaluate the performance of the proposed robust model, a number of test problems are generated, and a commercial optimization solver is used to solve these problems. Experimentation shows that incorporating uncertainty via scenarios decreases makespan when compared to deterministic scheduling methods.

articleTitle: Pricing and lot sizing in a two level supply chain with supplier process breakdown and random repairing time
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: In this paper, we study the joint pricing and lot sizing problems for a two level supply chain under supplier production breakdown and random repairing time. The supplier and the retailer follow a Stackelberg gaming approach, in which the supplier is the leader and the retailer is the follower. For the supplier, two production strategies, i.e., the flexible strategy (Strategy F) and the inflexible strategy (Strategy IF), are studied. When utilizing strategy F, the supplier sets a planned production time and an additional reserve time. When utilizing strategy IF, the supplier only sets a planned production time. Comparing the two strategies, we find that by utilizing the flexible strategy, both parties in the supply chain can be better off. By conducting a numerical test, some other managerial implications are found, which are also presented in the paper.

articleTitle: The optimization of the workflow in low-temperature distribution center based on Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: The optimization of the low-temperature distribution center process can not only reduce the risk of products deterioration in circulation, but also lower the energy consumption and environmental pollution during the running of low-temperature distribution center. The paper firstly introduces the major process of low-temperature distribution center, and establishes the Petri Net of low-temperature distribution center based on the overall flow chart. Next, the paper decomposes the overall process into independent and purposive flow units, builds corresponding incidence matrix, and analyzes the relationship between different flow units through Petri Net. Then, we find out the flow units where “conflict” and “synchronous” coexisting, the paper analyzes the key flow units that influence the efficiency of overall flow and proposes optimization scheme for key units. Finally, the paper uses Visual Object Net++ software's built-in simulation function to calculate two Petri Net before and after optimization, quantifies optimized result.

articleTitle: Surgical scheduling with participators' behavior considerations under multiple resource constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Operation room scheduling not only deals with deciding on the time to perform the surgeries in the case of full and efficient utilization of medical resources and guaranteeing surgery quality for patients, but also needs to consider how to respond to emergency cases. Under the limited hospital resources constraints, this task plays a significant role in providing timely treatments for the emergency patients while considering the conflicting interests of several stakeholders involved (e.g., elective patients, OR managers, medical staff) and achieving all their different objectives. By comparing emergency cases scheduling and the disruption problem of unexpected new arrival orders in manufacturing, this paper focuses on the main behavioral participators in the surgery operation process to measure deviations based on the prospect theory, and formulates the bicriteria model which considers both the original objective and the deviation with the knowledge gained in FFSSP. A universal heuristic algorithm, NSGA-III, is proposed numerical experiments are performed to efficiently solve this model. Numerical experiments are performed by integrating testing dataset in Pham et al and the results showed a superior performance of deviation measure based on prospect theory.

articleTitle: Dual policy environment and the quality of the Big Four audit service
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: All along, the Big Four accounting firms are considered to provide a uniform and high standard of audit services, but whether it is as it claims to offer a unified and a high standard audit service, few scholars study this regard. China's capital market is the existence of a dual policy environment, which would provide a special policy context for our research. Based on this, we use the year of 2000-2012 Big Four A-share audit services data of the mainland China companies listed A shares and the company cross-listing in Hong Kong and mainland China, to research if there is difference in Big Four's audit fees audit service quality provided in for different policy environment.

articleTitle: Research on the defects and improvement of internal control of scientific research funds in colleges and universities based on FMEA model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: At present, the state has put forward the policy of revitalizing science and technology and further improving the management of scientific research projects in universities and colleges, so as to promote the development of science and technology. It puts forward higher requirements for the quality of scientific research project management in colleges and universities, there are some problems in the management of the traditional extensive research funds, such as the lag of the management information system, the low efficiency of the use of funds and the lack of supervision. How to find a scientific method from the perspective of internal control to measure and predict the use and management of scientific research funds is extremely important. In this paper, the FMEA method of risk control is applied to the internal control defects and risk assessment of the scientific research funds in colleges and universities, this paper provides a new methodology for the internal control of scientific research funds, in order to effectively allocate scientific research funds, to ensure the effectiveness and sustainability of the risk management of scientific research funds, in order to better serve the creative activities of scientific researchers.

articleTitle: The literature review of auditor changes
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper reviews relevant literature that is about causes and results of auditor changes. The paper contains main four parts of the literature: (1) Category of auditor changes, (2) Causes of auditor changes, (3) Results of auditor changes, (4) Remarks and suggestions for future research.

articleTitle: Information propagation model with official broadcast in metro emergency
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Metro emergency has always been the social concerned issues in which information diffusion is one of the most important concerns as sometimes it will decide the severity of the emergency. In the metro emergency, the passengers not only communicate with peers, but also be affected by the official information. Therefore, the opinion dynamic of passengers with the release of official information is mainly studied in this paper. In this paper, broadcast is seen as leader role as it is one of the most popular approaches to release the official information, and the passengers seen as followers. Therefore, based on the existing leader-follower BC model, we have made some improvements due to the features of broadcast itself, such as not able to move and releasing the same official information. By simulating the model by Netlogo, we mainly focus on the impacts of the time delay for officials releasing information. The simulation results are meaningful for the officials to control the information propagation in metro emergency.

articleTitle: A Markov Decision Process model for patient service sequence policy in digital subtraction angiography treatment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) is a technique used in radiology to clearly visualize blood vessels in a bony or dense soft tissue environment. It is widely applied in traumatology department and orthopedics. Usually, the amount of doctors qualified for DSA is limited, so not all the patients in emergency will be treated immediately. Patient's condition may get worse because of treatment delay. Considering this situation, a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process (MDP) model is proposed to solve this problem and improve current service quality in this paper. In this model, the priority for patients to have DSA is discussed when several patients, including patients with reservation and emergency patients, are waiting in the queue for treatment. The model is used to optimize the DSA service sequence policy, which aims to maximize the total rewards. The rewards include treatment rewards and postponing loss of all the patients. Simulation modeling is used to get computational results. Finally, the performance of the optimized policy is compared with the FCFS (first come first served) policy. The postponing loss of patients reduce by 53% and the total rewards of the hospital increase by 58%.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the effects of the separation of the control rights and cash flow rights on the stock price synchronization of listed companies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: The synchronization of stock price in recent years is the hot topic of corporate finance. In this paper, we use the data of A share listed companies in China in 2010–2015 to study the barrier of separation of two rights (control right and cash flow right) to market information transmission characterized by stock price synchronization. The results show that: firstly, the separation of the two powers and the nature of the actual controller are positively related to the stock price synchronization. Secondly, the state-owned property of the actual controller significantly reduces the positive impact of the separation of the two rights on the stock price synchronicity.

articleTitle: Research on video platform competition considering quality difference and network externality
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Based on the network externalities, this paper constructs a Hotelling model to study the quality competition between pay video platform and free video platform. Result finds that, only when the intensity of self-network externality is high as well as consumers are less bored with advertising, or when the intensity of self-network externality is low and consumers are extremely tired of advertising, the program quality and profit of pay video platform will be higher than the free one. Otherwise, the program quality and profit of the free video platform will be higher.

articleTitle: The roll transportation scheduling of Qiongzhou Strait optimization and simulation based on Petri net
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: To solve the problem with low level of service, scheduling chaos, the high cost in roll transport system. A hybrid Petri net (HPN) model with optimal dispatching scheme is established by optimizing the passenger wheel scheduling and using the non-stationary Poisson process to simulate the arrival law of the passenger roller. Based on the HPN model, a Simio simulation model of Qiongzhou Strait transportation is constructed, Determined the optimal scheduling scheme of passenger rolling transportation system. Simulation results show that the maximum waiting waiting length of the port is reduced 80% and the average transportation time is shortened by 24%, which proves that the scheduling optimization can effectively alleviate the problem of roll transport system.

articleTitle: Sellers channel choice and optimal pricing on heterogeneous online platforms
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper sets an analytical model to study the decision problem of a seller facing two heterogeneous online platforms—the for-profit platform and the open platform. Consumers' acceptance of the open platform and the different cost for selling on heterogeneous platforms are considered in the model. Three research questions are discussed: How should the seller choose the platforms to trade on, the for-profit platform, the open platform or the both? If the seller trade on both of the heterogeneous platforms, how should he/she set price on them? How will the consumers' acceptance of the open platform affect the seller's optimal choice? The main finding indicates that seller's optimal channel choice is varying with the consumers' acceptance of the open platform. When the consumers' acceptance rate of the open platform is low, the seller's optimal choice is to selling on the for-profit platform only; When the acceptance rate is in a middle range, selling on both of the heterogeneous platforms is the optimal option; When the acceptance rate is high, the seller's optimal choice is to selling on the open platform only.

articleTitle: Research on brand-owner's pricing decisions considering its strategic decisions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: This paper constructs a two-tier supply chain consisting of one brand-owner and the one electronic commerce company. The brand-owner has strategic decision ability to decide when and how to introduce electronic platform to sell products. We discuss brand-owner's pricing decisions in three models based on fixed pricing strategy or dynamic pricing strategy. We find some interesting conclusions: i). There is being a perfect pricing strategy for both consumer and brand-owner, that is the extended model based on dynamic pricing strategy; ii). When brand-owner adopts fixed pricing strategy, more strategic consumers in the market do not necessarily make brand-owner more benefit; when brand-owner uses dynamic pricing strategy, more strategic consumers can make brand-owner more benefit. iii). Under varied competition environment, pursuing of long-term profits maximization is always better for brand-owner when it considers of strategic profits-oriented preference.

articleTitle: Collective bargaining: Cooperation mechanism in two-sided platform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: We study a collective bargaining under which sellers form an alliance to jointly join a platform. Although sellers in a platform compete to gain more buyers, their cooperation can reduce the transaction fees charged by the platform. Moreover, sellers' bargaining with the platform may have an effect on buyers' transaction fees. We first analyze the basic model that sellers decide to join the platform separately, and then compare prices and profits that sellers cooperate with others with the benchmark. We find that sellers might obtain lower transaction fees and are always better off under collective bargaining. So sellers set a lower price to buyers. The platform's profit is cannibalized although it charges more from buyers. Our analysis shows that collective bargaining benefits buyers.

articleTitle: Price-rate tradeoff in a service system with two servers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: The main goal of our study is to find the optimal service rate and service price to retain customers in a 2-servers service system where customers may flow to the quicker server. In common queuing systems, the initial demand is divided into equal demands to each server. But, when customers are wait too long in a queue, they may turn to join another queue which have an impact on effective arriving rate of each queue. We study this kind of phenomenon from a queueing game theoretic point of view. We start with studying the equilibrium performances in a general M/M/2 service system where customers join a single queue. Then we extent the results to the target service system and obtain the optimal service rate and service price of the system. Some sensitivity analysis are also included in this paper.

articleTitle: How do consumers make online brand decision?
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: In this study, we firstly define brand decision as two kinds, one brand choice and multi-brands choice. By using multiple linear regression model and multinomial logit model separately, we construct links between brand identity, brand communication, electronic word of mouth and brand choice (one-brand and multi-brands). We find brand identity, brand communication and eWOM are positively associated with consumers' one-brand choice decision. We also find brand identity and brand communication do have impacts on consumers' multi-brands choice decision. Brand identity plays a very important role in consumers' brand choice. However, surprising to us, eWOM is insignificantly linked with multi-brands choice.

articleTitle: Optimal pricing and investing policies for digital products with piracy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Digital content industry, listed as China's “key cultural industries”, has maintained high-speed growth in recent years. However, challenges still remain since piracy has become obstacles in long-term sustainable development. A firm may employ different pricing and investing policies with differentiated environmental conditions to protect intellectual property, increase legitimate sales and maximize the firm's benefits. Based on the assumption that the firm uses a skimming strategy, we establish three models to analyze the pricing and investing decisions of the firm selling a product with continuous saturation effect over time and pirated easily. All the optimal pricing and investing policies that maximize profits can be applied to a wide variety of digital industries such as entertainment and online office industries.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the influencing factors of consumers' trust transfer from offline to online channel
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: As the key to both offline and online business, consumers' trust to retailers always influences their purchase decision. In recent years, based on the traditional business, more and more click and mortar companies spring up. But could consumers' trust transfer from offline to online channel? And how? Extant researches lack deep exploration for these questions. In this study, introducing perceived ease of use and perceived usefulness as mediators, and taking perceived security and perceived compatibility into account, we build a research model. Then data are gathered by the method of questionnaire after online practice, and the model and hypotheses are tested by Structured Equation Model software. The research results show that: Firstly, consumers' trust to offline channel of a company, significantly positively affect their trust to its online channel, which finally influences their intention to purchase online, by the complete mediation of consumers' perceived usefulness of e-business websites; Secondly, consumers' perceived compatibility has positive effect on their trust to online business. But the effect of perceived ease of use and perceived security on consumers' trust to online business isn't significant.

articleTitle: The game in Service Supply Chain for the aged
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: The purpose of this study is to research the game relationship between nursing institution for the aged (N) and the aged (A) in the service supply chain for the aged. Three situations are analyzed, calculated and discussed according to a comprehensive mathematical model. Based on the model hypotheses that are close to reality and a series of tight argument, we have found ten conclusions which offer some valuable guidance to service supply chain for the aged in practice.

articleTitle: The relationship between firm characteristic variables and stock returns: An empirical study based on principal component analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: A large number of empirical studies show that the firm characteristic variables, including the firm size, book to market ratio (B/M), momentum and etc., they have a certain correlation with future stock returns. However, the information contained in many stock feature variables is too complicated, there is a linear correlation between them, leading to overlapping problems of the information. So in the study of stock returns, how to avoid information overlapping is worth studying. Based on this starting point, this paper uses principal component analysis method to extract new principal component variables from many variables that reflect the characteristics of stocks, and then use the new variables combined with Fama-Macbethe regression to predict future stock returns. It is of great theoretical and practical significance for the investors to make full use of the real-time information of the stock market, to effectively create the investment strategy and master the law of the securities market.

articleTitle: Intertemporal pricing strategies for fashion tech products with consumer externalities
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Fashion tech products have both fashion elements and functional elements. These dual attributes lead to two opposite consumption externalities: on one hand, the fewer users, the more utilities she can get; on the other hand, a consumer will be more likely to buy when there are more buyers. Taking these two opposite effects into account, we study the optimal intertemporal pricing strategies assuming that customers are heterogeneous in their intrinsic values of the product. Our results suggest how firms should adjust their optimal pricing strategies under different market circumstances.

articleTitle: The private label introducing for a B2C platform firm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Private label has become an important strategy for retailers and B2C platform to gain competitive advantages. This paper investigates product introduction and position of B2C platform's private label in a distribution channel composed of one manufacturer and one B2C platform. Results indicate that introducing private label can create a win-win situation for both the B2C platform firm and the national brand manufacturer, and the production cost of private label is an important factor for B2C platform to introduce private label. The analysis suggests the position decisions depend on parameters like product base demand, production costs, and product substitutability. We show that a private label will benefit the manufacturer and the platform under certain conditions. The optimal PL position lies on the segment that manufacturer's profit and platform's profit could increase.

articleTitle: Household savings rates and housing prices in China—Based on cohort analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Based on the perspective of cohort analysis, this paper examines the empirical relationship between housing prices and household savings rates in China by using family tracking survey data (CFPS) as sample. We find that the appreciation of housing prices can lead to household savings rates to decline, and changes in housing prices by 1 unit produce decreases in household savings rates by 2.2 units, the robust tests support our conclusions. The age curve of savings rates shows that the savings rates of the elder cohort is lower than that of the younger cohort, which is in accordance with life-cycle theory.

articleTitle: The role of managers' overconfidence on the irrational investment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Listed companies' irrational investment behavior was widespread in China. Traditional theory explain this phenomenon in the assumption of “rational economic man”. With the development of behavioral finance theory, research indicates that over-confidence can lead to over-investment decisions. This paper used Richardson's residual model to measure over-investment and creatively used shares' rises when ROE fall as the measure of overconfidence. We introduced cross item to further study on free cash flow's effect. By analyzing data from 2010 to 2014, we conclude that: (1) Managers' overconfidence is positively related to the over-investment. (2) When add the cross terms, the degree of overconfidence impose on over-investment is strengthen; (3) Contrast to that in non-manufacture, in manufacture, managers' overconfidence are negatively related to excessive investment; (4) Before 2015, the influencing factors contains overconfidence, cash flow, leverage, size and other factors. However, the influencing factors contains only overconfidence in 2015, corporate factors is no longer significant.

articleTitle: The coordination problem of fresh agricultural products supply chain with option contract based on product quality
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: The paper investigates a two-echelon fresh agricultural products supply chain(FAPSC) consisting of a supplier and a retailer in which the demand of the retailer is both price and quality sensitive. The wholesale price contract and the option contract based on fresh agricultural products quality is researched. The optimal decisions of the FAPSC with and without option contract are analyzed. The result shows that the retailer orders more in the FAPSC with option contract compared to that without option contract. The supplier also has incentives to improve the quality of the fresh agricultural products when the option contract is adopted. The profits of the supplier and the retailer in the FAPSC with option contract are also more than that in the FAPSC without option contract. At last, extensive numerical experiments are conducted to verify the behaviors of the FAPSC members.

articleTitle: Port governance in Ivory Coast
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Ivory Coast's ports are ports that currently have a part landlord, part public service port management model. This combination of a landlord port management model and of a public service port management model faces many controversies. In this article, the port governance in Ivory Coast is analyzed since the foundation of its two ports until today and the development of its ports since their creation is divided into three periods: the colonial period (1951–1959), the independence period (1960–1999) and the private participation period (2000-present). Good and bad effects of each period on port governance are presented and the challenges faced by the current port management model are addressed. Some suggestions on making new reforms for the good development of Ivory Coast's ports are given to conclude.

articleTitle: Optimal shelf space strategy for the fresh agricultural product with a two-warehouse inventory system
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: The optimal shelf space strategy for the fresh agricultural product in a two-warehouse inventory system is studied in which the different loss rates of the agricultural product reserved in the backup warehouse and displayed on the shelf space are considered. The instantaneous inventory levels in the back-up warehouse and on the shelf are got. Then the loss rate and holding cost of the fresh agricultural product are got. The optimal conditions of the shelf space and retail price under which the retailer can get the optimal profit are got. The results are illustrated by numerical examples and sensitivity analysis is carried out.

articleTitle: Service innovation model within service industry
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Service innovation has become a key factor to enterprises' competitiveness. Enterprises must constantly engage in innovation activities to maintain their competitive advantage. This study examines the case of Lungyen Life Service Corporation. The funeral industry of Taiwan is in great need of modernization and new concepts from service innovation. Past studies related to the funeral industry focused on industrial modernization management, business strategy of life service corporations, overview of pre-need funeral contract and funeral contract, the role of modern funeral directors, as well as funeral directors and funeral services. However, few studies examined service innovation in the funeral industry.

articleTitle: The empirical research on the influence of managerial overconfidence on the mergers and acquisitions decision
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: In recent years, merger and acquisition has become the main means of expanding for Chinese listed companies. Meanwhile, the manager has played an increasingly important role when the company tries to make acquisitions. Based on the viewpoint of behavioral finance, managers are more likely to become overconfident. Therefore, it is very necessary to apply the theory of managerial overconfidence to the research on motivation of M&A. This paper selects company samples listed between 2013 and 2015 in Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchange to do an empirical research about the effect of managerial overconfidence on mergers and acquisitions decision. The conclusion shows that managerial overconfidence significantly influences the mergers and acquisitions decision. In other words, overconfident managers are more inclined to implement mergers and acquisitions.

articleTitle: Preface
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: ICSSSM is a conference series, organized annually, focusing on state-of-the-art research in service systems and service management. The 14th ICSSSM is jointly sponsored by IEEE Systems, Man and Cybernetics Society, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Tsinghua University, and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics. It is hosted by the School of Management Science and Engineering, Dongbei University of Finance and Economics, Dalian. The main purpose of ICSSSM is to provide a platform for researchers, scholars, practitioners and students involved in the broad area of service systems and service management to disseminate their latest research results, as well as to exchange views on the future research directions.

articleTitle: Exploring the influencing factors on service recovery satisfaction of group-buying websites
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Service characteristic of intangible, concurrency and heterogeneity, which make it quite normal that service error appear in the process of companies management. Despite the virtual nature of e-commerce, online retailers also have service failures. Taking group-buying websites as an example, this paper explores the factors influencing the customer satisfaction from the perspective of service quality by combing the mechanism of service recovery and customer satisfaction, and provides suggestions for group-buying websites operators. The results show that service quality, service result quality and service recovery quality all contribute to the improvement of customer satisfaction. The research results have important practical significance for the online retailers to improve customer satisfaction, to make up for service errors, and to increase the stickiness of users to websites.

articleTitle: The influence of critical factors on the demand of the international electricity engineering contracting: ISM approach
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Demand of the international electricity engineering contracting is not only influenced by the factors from the internal of the electricity system, but the factors about electricity planning, macroeconomic, new energy development and so on. To distinguish the interaction and interrelationship between them, Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM) methodology is used to identify the interrelationship among the identified factors in the present investigation. Moreover, we reveal the root cause, the shallow cause and the surface cause influencing the demand of the international electricity engineering contracting, which provides decision-supporting for the future forecasting about the size of the electricity engineering contracting.

articleTitle: A rule-based system to support carbon resource planning under C&T conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: As part of a larger research project, this study addresses issues of risk-based decision-making based on different decision-makers in carbon resource planning for manufacturers under the constraints of C&T, we specify their characterization of behavior, attitude to the C&T program, and design their rule-based expert system (RBS) respectively. we develop discrete-event simulation models for conservative decision-maker and proactive decision-maker to conduct experimental analyzes. More than three years of efforts have been made on extensive literature review and empirical studies (such as site-visits and meetings) to identify the problem and define system models for intended analysis. A baseline model has been implemented with ARENA© and limited experiments were conducted to verify the basic functions. While the preliminary results confirmed with the expectations about the system behavior and validated the original ideas, tremendous work remains in terms of model implementation, modification and experiments.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between industrial agglomeration and talent agglomeration Take Jiangsu as an Example
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: Using the panel data of thirteen provincial cities in China's Jiangsu Province, this paper analyzes the interactive relationship between industrial agglomeration and talent agglomeration in Jiangsu Province on the basis of elaborating the interaction mechanism between them, and draws lessons from European Union's “smart specialization” policy to make targeted recommendations. Our results show that: The relationship between the first industrial agglomeration and talent agglomeration in Jiangsu Province is undefined. Talent agglomeration has a significant positive impact on the secondary industrial agglomeration. Tertiary industrial agglomeration and talent agglomeration interplay each other, and there exists a symbiotic and multiplier effect between them.

articleTitle: Production mode choice under carbon tax
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: We analyze two production ways of manufacturers: costly green production and less expensive non-green production. The former emits less green house gas, while the latter does more harm to global warming. We suppose there are three possible production strategies for a manufacturer: low cost production, dual production, and green mass market production. With an assumption that “green” consumers are willing to pay a higher price for a product produced in the green way, we derive the condition under which each strategy is optimal and come to conclusions that efforts intended to increase consumers' willingness to pay for green products or increase the number of green consumers may lead to unanticipated outcomes, such as a rise in carbon emission. By contrast, efforts that focus on policies imposed on manufacturers, such as higher carbon tax, can lead to reduced carbon emission and increased green production.

articleTitle: Optimizing fare and operational strategies for an urban bus corridor using elastic demand
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: In order to better match supply and demand in public transit (PT) systems, this paper proposes operational strategies and fare models for a single bus line, subject to bus capacity constraints and budget restrictions. The objective of this model is to maximize the total social profit with a weighted combination of the operator's profit and consumer surplus. For the purposes of this study, operator profit results from PT services that generate welfare for the service provider, and consumer surplus is a result of the welfare of the users generated by PT services. To improve the efficiency of a PT system and the application of optimal models, we consider passenger demand as elasticity and formulate the function of demand with respect to generalized costs including travel fare, waiting time costs, in-vehicle time costs, as well as transfer costs. A case is given, and numerical results are presented. It is found that by maximizing total social profit, the optimal combination of bus fare and operational strategies can be efficiently reached. The results show that applying operational strategies could achieve greater social welfare, attract more passengers, and reduce the fleet size. With the optimal value of the objective function, operator profit accounts for a small proportion. When budget restrictions are considered in the model, operator profit only breaks even. Through analyzing components of passenger travel costs, we find that waiting times and transfer costs have a significant impact on passengers' travel behaviors. Furthermore, in comparison with bus fares determined by objective functions such as social welfare, social profit, etc., the optimal bus fare generated by maximization of operator profit is higher.

articleTitle: Study on the social force model of personnel evacuation in large stadiums
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: It is a valuable question that how to evacuate the people rapidly and effectively in the large stadiums when the emergency event happened. The people has discontinuous, nonlinear and complex behavior characteristics in the evacuation process, and the architectural features of the stadiums have a direct impact on the evacuation time. In this paper, it studied on the relationship between the exit width, the thickness of the exit, the expected speed and the evacuation time using social force model. the results show that that there is an asymptotic relationship between the characteristics of the structures and the evacuation time, and the evacuation time reaches the optimal value with the change of the expected speed. The results can be used to guide the design of large stadiums and evacuation plans.

articleTitle: Choosing the fastest route for urban distribution based on big data of vehicle travel time
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Service Systems and Service Management
abstract: With the increase in the number of urban cars, the city's road congestion is getting heavier and heavier. Often, we choose the shortest path to reduce costs and improve efficiency during logistics distribution, but now, in order to improve timeliness, it is necessary to choose the fastest route to deliver because of traffic jams. This paper proposes a method to select the fastest route based on big data of vehicle travel time, replacing distance values with travel time values, by using the improved Floyd algorithm. The method can improve the efficiency of urban distribution and reduce the time cost, and has significant application value.
